headline: UN Delays Least Developed Status Exit for Bangladesh and Nepal
summary: The United Nations delayed the graduation of Bangladesh and Nepal from least developed status, allowing them to retain trade and financing benefits amid global economic pressures.
why: Extended trade preferences and concessional financing help developing nations buffer against external macroeconomic shocks and support ongoing debt sustainability.

impacts.name: Bangladesh
impacts.why: Bangladesh retains trade and financing benefits following the UN delay.
